idea: i ate a very good burger in tel aviv

hooks.en: Best burger of my life? Tel Aviv.
hooks.hi: ज़िंदगी का बेस्ट बर्गर? तेल अवीव में मिला।
hooks.hinglish: Life ka best burger? Tel Aviv mein mila.
hooks.shot: Close-up of the burger being squeezed so the juice drips onto the plate.
hooks.why: A strong personal claim tied to a city nobody links with burgers makes people want to see the proof.

hooks.en: I didn't come to Tel Aviv for burgers.
hooks.hi: मैं तेल अवीव बर्गर खाने नहीं आया था।
hooks.hinglish: Main Tel Aviv burger khaane nahi aaya tha.
hooks.onScreen: Came for the beach. Stayed for this.
hooks.shot: Creator walking a Tel Aviv street, then turning to show the burger in hand.
hooks.why: It sets up a surprise, so viewers stay to find out what changed their mind.

hooks.en: Would you fly to Israel for a burger?
hooks.hi: एक बर्गर के लिए इज़राइल जाओगे?
hooks.hinglish: Ek burger ke liye Israel jaoge?
hooks.shot: Creator holding the burger up to the camera with the restaurant behind them.
hooks.why: A yes-or-no question invites comments and makes viewers judge the burger for themselves.

hooks.en: POV: you bite into a Tel Aviv burger.
hooks.hi: POV: तेल अवीव का बर्गर पहली बाइट में।
hooks.hinglish: POV: Tel Aviv ka burger, pehli bite.
hooks.shot: First-person shot of the burger coming toward the camera for a bite.
hooks.why: Putting the viewer in the seat makes the first bite feel like theirs.

hooks.en: Forget hummus. Tel Aviv's burgers are the move.
hooks.hi: हम्मस भूल जाओ, तेल अवीव में बर्गर खाओ।
hooks.hinglish: Hummus bhool jao, Tel Aviv mein burger khao.
hooks.shot: A hand pushing a plate of hummus aside to reveal the burger.
hooks.why: It goes against what people expect to eat in Israel, which makes them stop and argue.

hooks.en: One bite in Tel Aviv, and I went quiet.
hooks.hi: तेल अवीव में एक बाइट, और मैं चुप।
hooks.hinglish: Tel Aviv mein ek bite, aur main chup.
hooks.shot: Creator mid-bite, eyes closing, with no talking for a beat.
hooks.why: A real reaction is more convincing than any adjective, and viewers wait to hear the verdict.
